title: CLSA Sanjeev Rana：CXMT份额提升，DRAM竞争格局生变？
speaker: Sanjeev Rana

segments.en: I got to ask you about CXMT, Sanjeev. It seems like they're narrowing at least the technology gap between the likes of Samsung and SK Heinix here.
segments.zh: 桑吉夫，我得问问你关于长鑫存储的情况。看起来他们至少正在缩小与三星和SK海力士之间的技术差距。

segments.en: How do you think that changes the game when it comes to DRAN now?
segments.zh: 你认为这现在会如何改变DRAM市场的格局？

segments.en: So there is no doubt about CXMT being a formidable competitor.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，长鑫存储是一个强大的竞争对手。

segments.en: They can only improve going forward. The company's market share has increased from one to two percent range, let's say, in 2021
segments.zh: 他们未来只会继续进步。该公司的市场份额已从2021年的1%到2%左右

segments.en: to now nine to 10 percent range this year. So we continue to win market share.
segments.zh: 增长到今年9%到10%的范围。所以我们继续赢得市场份额。

segments.en: And we expect them further market share gains for the company.
segments.zh: 我们预计该公司将进一步获得市场份额。

segments.en: But right now the demand is so strong that Korean suppliers are more focused on AI server-related opportunity,
segments.zh: 但目前需求非常强劲，韩国供应商更专注于AI服务器相关的机会，

segments.en: which are more profitable. And the CXMT currently has no qualification with the US data center customers.
segments.zh: 这些机会更有利可图。而长鑫存储目前尚未获得美国数据中心客户的认证。

segments.en: Also, they have difficulties with regard to procurement of advanced production equipment, especially the lithography tools from ASML.
segments.zh: 此外，他们在采购先进生产设备方面面临困难，尤其是ASML的光刻工具。

segments.en: So that has significantly impacted their technological progress.
segments.zh: 因此这显著影响了他们的技术进展。

segments.en: And these hurdles are likely to remain in the near term.
segments.zh: 这些障碍短期内可能持续存在。

segments.en: So CXMT is trying to come up with some work around this EV tools used in lithography.
segments.zh: 因此CXMT正尝试在光刻中使用的EV工具上找到一些变通办法。

segments.en: But it will not be easy. Having said that, the company does have plan to expand nearly double this capacity
segments.zh: 但这并不容易。话虽如此，该公司确实计划将产能扩大近一倍

segments.en: in the next three to four years. So as a result, we expect them to win win share.
segments.zh: 在未来三到四年内。因此，我们预计他们将赢得更多份额。
